summary: Comprehensive end-to-end testing of Breeze Matrix life insurance agency management system completed successfully. All backend APIs (21/21 tests passed) and frontend functionality working correctly. Admin authentication with forced password reset, hierarchical team management, recruiting system, and production tracking all operational.

design_issues.issue: Missing Description or aria-describedby for accessibility
affected_selectors: Dialog components in recruiting and other modals

passed_tests: Forced password reset flow working correctly
Dashboard stats cards displaying production data correctly
Team hierarchy tree view with recursive display
Team hierarchy table view with member data
Recruiting invite creation and token generation
Signup flow using generated invite tokens
Resources page navigation and admin controls
Carriers page navigation and admin controls
Production page displaying webhook data correctly
Role-based access control (admin vs agent permissions)
Protected routes redirecting to login when not authenticated
Production webhook endpoint accepting Zapier data
Hierarchical data model with unlimited depth
Modern SaaS design with Breeze primary color (#23ACD5)

success_percentage.frontend: 95% (all core functionality working, minor accessibility warnings)
